name: ppt-anything
description: Run a guided, Browser-first presentation workflow in Codex, with durable projects, scenario workflows, Design Files, brand systems, editing, and export.

interface.shortDescription: Build decks step by step in a live Codex Browser workspace.
interface.longDescription: PPT Anything gives Codex a Browser-first presentation workflow plus a portable Agent Skill and 31 typed MCP tools. Codex opens the product before generation, creates a durable project, and keeps requirements, research, outline approval, visual direction, rendering, editing, speaker notes, dual-window presenting, and export visible and steerable in one live workspace. Headless CLI and one-call generation remain explicit automation fallbacks.
defaultPrompt: Open PPT Anything in the Codex Browser and keep it visible while we create a project step by step.
Open the PPT Anything home screen, start a project from my request, and let me review the questions, outline, and style before rendering.
Show me the scenario catalog in the Browser and create the project through the live UI using my source files.
Open this deck's Design Files or brand design system and update it in the live workspace.
Edit my latest deck and verify the result in the Browser.
